passage.label: these disbelievers saying not but first death not resurrected; bring forefathers if truthful; better or people Tubba those before destroyed criminals; not create heavens earth between play; created except truth most not know; Day Judgement appointed time all; Day no relation avail relation nor helped; except those Allah mercy Exalted Might Merciful

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

mainSubject.label: Disbelievers' denial reduced to asserting only the first death and rejecting resurrection, challenged to produce their forefathers if truthful; comparison with Tubba's people and earlier destroyed criminals affirming they are not superior; creation declared purposeful rather than playful, established in truth though most do not know; the Day of Judgement named the appointed time for all when no kinship avails and no help arrives save for those upon whom Allah has mercy, the Mighty and Merciful

subordinateSubjects.label: Disbelievers quoted as denying anything beyond the first death and rejecting resurrection
Challenge to bring back their forefathers if they are truthful
Rhetorical question whether they are better than Tubba's people and earlier nations
Their destruction affirmed because they were criminals
Creation of heavens, earth and what lies between denied as play
Creation affirmed as being in truth though most do not know
The Day of Judgement named the appointed time for them all
No relation availing another on that Day and no help arriving
Exception made for those upon whom Allah has mercy, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Denial of resurrection reduced to asserting only the first death with a challenge to produce forefathers
Kinship rendered entirely useless on the Day of Judgement with no help arriving

relationships.label: Creation declared purposeful and in truth against the assumption of play
Mercy as the sole exception to universal helplessness on the Day of Judgement

notes: Wave 7 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the greatest-assault retribution (16) before the Pharaoh trial narrative opens (17); P2 ends with Israel's election and signs (33); P3 covers the denial-of-resurrection block through the mercy exception (34-42); P4 runs from Zaqqum through the righteous reward and the closing mutual-watch command (43-59).
